# Context from my IDE setup:

## Active file: tacto-negotiator/docs/v2/implementation-order-addendum-2026-10-10.md

## Active selection of the file:
# V2 capability delivery: approved implementation-order addendum

**Approved by the user:** checkpoints A and B progress together wherever dependencies allow.
Sections A–F retain the original assessment/proposal snapshot below; section G records the
subsequent implementation (with the latest evidence-to-economics integration in section K). No complete loop, persistence system, or whole DTO inventory is
required before independently implementing/testing interpretation, economics, or strategy.

10 October 2026. Assessment of checkout `a88bf86` **including the existing working-tree
planning/test changes**. This is a proposal, not an approved contract revision or a completion
claim. No production code, tests, fixtures, or existing planning documents were changed for
this assessment. Task IDs, architecture, and C's implemented-type contracts remain authoritative.

The smallest useful adjustment is to **implement contracts beside their first consumers,
and bring real evidence resolution, economics, validation, and behavioral evaluation forward**.
Do not wait for all D1–D16 to start component work. Do not promise that the complete existing
pipeline can use only a handful of DTOs: its current public input and result types have a
substantial transitive dependency closure.

## A. Actual state and architectural assessment

| Area | Inspected implementation state | Implication |
|---|---|---|
| T1.1a | Frozen values/terms, strict parsing, canonical serialization/hashes, errors implemented | Reuse unchanged |
| T1.1b | Assessment models and exact Protocol declarations implemented | Reuse; declarations referencing absent DTOs do not make the ports executable end to end |
| T1.1c | DecisionStage/DecisionRecord/EffectiveConfig and config resolver implemented | T1.3 composition and T1.4 record persistence remain unfinished |
| T1.1d | EvidenceScope, Provenance, TemporalValidity, DisclosureRule implemented | All 160 remaining declared exports are absent: 146 concrete DTOs plus 14 unions |
| T1.2a/b | No recorded adapter, factory, or orchestration loop | Normalizer, scripted fakes, and sentinel routing test are preparation |
| T2–T6 | No concrete V2 evidence, interpreter, economics, strategy, execution, store, or evaluation components | Planned tests and V1 implementations are reuse material, not delivered V2 capabilities |
| V1 | Existing negotiator, arithmetic integrations, adviser, evidence, runtime, Lab infrastructure | Preserve named historical baseline; wrap useful primitives rather than assume current callers are safe |

Fresh local verification in this pass:

- `tests/v2`: **380 passed, 796 xfailed**, no unexpected failures. Many passes validate
  specification examples; the 796 explicit missing-component/DTO xfails are not completed work.
- Ruff over `src/negotiator/v2 tests/v2`: passes.
- Frozen V1 replay: exact historical first move matches `3653046`; no network/model calls.
- Six focused legacy modules from A's verification recipe: **56 passed, 4 failed**.
  Failures remain the inverse-price regression, two final-offer history/memory expectations,
  and empty-thread mocked-agent compatibility (`test_evaluator.py` and `test_context.py`).
  This is a bounded check, not a full repository readiness claim.

Preserve evidence / interpretation / strategy / economics / validation / execution /
orchestration boundaries, dependency injection, strict contracts, deterministic finances,
independent validation, source applicability/provenance, reproducible records, and the pinned
official kit. Keep the existing serial coordinator and SQLite direction. Preserve V1 goldens
and audit obligations in A §4. The source inspected still contains the legacy inverse helper,
separate cost access, and mutable runtime paths; none becomes safe through this proposal.

The avoidable dependencies are **whole-task barriers**: T1.2a, T1.4, T2.1, and T4.1 name
all of T1.1d; the instructions require the exact serial D1–D16 order; T6.1 waits for M5.
T5.1 also waits for all of T2.3 even for an offer with no factual claims. These are broader
than their first consumers need. Preserve real prerequisites: constructors need their field
types and complete union members; economic joins need verified basis/standards; grounding needs
actual source/message references; sending needs validation and durable ownership.

## B. Minimal roadmap delta and critical path

Keep M0–M7 and T identifiers. A–E below are **capability checkpoints across existing tasks**,
not replacement milestone IDs. A partial parent remains in progress until all its original
acceptance criteria pass. Keep shared-model edits serial; a new component may follow each
dependency-complete contract handoff rather than waiting for all batches.

| Checkpoint | Required work and order using existing IDs | Exit gate / status |
|---|---|---|
| A: functional backbone | T1.1d types on demand; T1.2a P10 binding; T1.3 offline composition; T1.4 artifact/record append/reload; T1.2b complete typed loop. Bring T4.1 official package evaluation and the used offer/question subset of T5.1 forward. Context, interpretation, strategy, generation and feedback may initially be recorded ports | Actual ten-stage loop, deterministic costs, independent used-action checks, fake execution and feedback, saved/reloaded trace. **Required next, not implemented; scripted intelligence explicitly labelled** |
| B: evidence-driven intelligence | Start T2.1 now; replace A's mock context with resolver-backed context. T3.1 labels + T6.1 local behavioral controls start now. Add T3.2 bounded deterministic interpretation/fallback and grounded draft validation, T4.2 finite generation, T4.3 evidence-conditioned proposal and deterministic selector. Add needed T2.3 standards/estimate projections; add T2.2 preparation when reading real package data | Relevant evidence/reply changes alter defensible intent and, when affordable/legal, selected action; irrelevant wording does not. Actual interpretation/strategy algorithms, evaluator and validator run. **Required next after/alongside backbone** |
| C: reliable execution | Complete used-scope T2.2/2.3 and T5.1; T5.2 projector + atomic state/operation/claim transaction; T5.3 endpoint gateway/executor/recovery; T5.4 serial multi-turn loop and basic feedback. Add minimum T3.3 budget plumbing if using a model. T6.2 only for the intended CLI/Lab launch path | Local simulator plus crash/uncertain-outcome/restart gates before any real execution. Live readiness remains separate from local proof and needs operational authorization. **Required later** |
| D: experimental framework | Register baseline and evidence-conditioned bundles through existing T1.3/T4.3 seams; extend T6.1 to identical recorded situations. Add T4.4 bounded LLM selector and T3.3/3.4 interpretation/provider evaluations when chosen and funded; T6.3/6.4 retain performance/promotion gates | Same evidence/economic/validation services, distinct strategy/config identities, held-out reports. Basic substitutability checked already in A/B. **Required later; model selector optional** |
| E: advanced capabilities | Retain T2.4 broader documents, T4.5 generic solver, T7.1–7.5 category/information-value/async/research/basket expansion and F's research queue. Sophisticated memory, preference estimation and attribution algorithms remain here | Enable on concrete requirement or measured gap. **Deferred; optional experiments remain optional** |

Shortest credible paths, with no full-parent completion hidden in these arrows:

1. **Offline loop:** dependency-complete T1.1d groups → P10-only T1.2a → T1.3
   composition + T1.4 append/load → T1.2b with real T4.1 and a real T5.1 used-action
   subset → checkpoint A. Storage is append-only decision/artifact storage at this stage;
   do not require the full live StateStore implementation to replay a decision.
2. **Evidence-sensitive decision:** T2.1 resolver/context + T3.1/T6.1 controls → T3.2
   bounded real interpretation → T4.2/T4.3 + necessary T2.3 projections → run through A's
   economic/validation pipeline → checkpoint B. The first bounded interpreter may safely
   recognize structured offers and explicit supported signals, preserving exact citations and
   unknowns. It must derive outputs from current inputs, not select prewritten assessments by
   fixture ID. Broader language coverage uses the same port and later evaluated model adapter.
3. **Reliable real execution:** B + strict data preflight/relationship estimates → full
   used-scope T5.1 → T5.2 → T5.3 → T5.4, intended launch-path checks and runtime fault matrix
   → checkpoint C. No model is required for a deterministic baseline. If enabled, its absolute
   budget/cancellation/fallback gates are prerequisites to transmitting.

Do not let A become another long framework project. Replace each scripted decision component
as its types become available; use T2.1 and T4.1 direct component demonstrations before A is
complete. Basic feedback is observed linkage, not learned causal attribution. Persist operation
identity/provenance before real sending; an unknown outcome retains its original ID/bytes and
blocks a conflicting action. All closing paths still need fresh standing-sheet checks and the
same deterministic close evaluator. Supplier prose never establishes terminal truth.

## C. DTO classification and limits of deferral

The existing layout can stay. Public cross-module contracts include evidence/context,
assessment, intent/candidate/evaluation/decision, validated action, operation, and result
envelopes. Nested contract helpers such as term origins and cost components also remain
explicit. Provider projection DTOs belong at the adapter boundary; hydrated events belong at
the store/projector boundary. They are not all necessary to *algorithm development*, but
their present contract placement is not a reason to migrate packages.

Private ranking scores, search queues, parser working structures, caches, and strategy-specific
reasoning can remain internal typed models. Do not add them to core speculatively. Existing
StrategyMemory supports owned payload schemas by reference; defer its algorithm, not its
referenced shape if NegotiationState already requires it. Empty tuples or disabled estimates
do not remove the need to define the complete declared type/union.

Static closure check: start with PreparedEvidence, DecisionSnapshot, IntentBatch,
GenerationResult, EvaluationBatch, NegotiationDecision, RenderedAction, ValidationResult,
PendingOperation, DispatchPermit, TransportBudget, ExecutionResult, EventProposal, ReplayResult,
VerifiedClaim and OfficialCostResult. Recursively follow field type names and every union member
in `tests/v2/dto-contracts.json`. This reaches **128 of 160 remaining exports** (DTOs and
unions), before any model/gateway envelopes. Adding ModelRequest, ModelBudget, ModelResult,
GatewayResult and ServerObservation for the existing integration seams reaches **148 of 160**.
These are schema dependency counts, not proof that a codec/test cutline needs exactly that
many; full port introspection and optional scenario bindings may require more. Record the

Implemented a bounded offline slice through the existing StrategyProposalPolicy,

- `strategy/testing.py`: SuppliedIntentTestPolicy emits fixed keep/optional registered clarify
  intents; MinimumCostTestSelector picks a supplied approved nominal-cost minimum, with stable
  ties and questions as a separate fallback category. These are **testing baselines, not intended
  negotiation intelligence**. They perform no language interpretation or opponent inference.
- `economics/finite.py`: SuppliedCandidateGenerator wraps at most 20 distinct supplied validated
  packages as single-package offers, or emits the one registered `clarify:terms` question. It
  performs no price search, snapping, optimization or economic calculation. Unsupported intent
  kinds, empty supply and budget overflow return explicit incomplete/error generation results.
- `economics/official.py`: evaluate_candidates delegates package arithmetic to the existing
  evaluate_package path. Candidate/evaluation/batch identities follow C's canonical projections.
  Calculable must-have/policy violations produce rejected candidates; malformed package joins
  fail the batch explicitly through ContractViolation rather than fabricate complete terms.
  The admitted comparison is nominal and the previously supported single explicit scenario.
- `execution/render.py`: TemplateActionRenderer verifies exact approved registered batch
  membership and renders fixed no-claim offer/question templates. It rejects invented/edited
  selection IDs, evaluation IDs, batches, unsupported questions and claims. Internal selector
  rationale and evidence assumptions never become outbound prose.
- `execution/validation.py`: FinalActionValidator reparses immutable boundary DTOs, independently
  recomputes every offered package through its injected evaluator, and checks explicit ceilings,
  state/session/recipient, pending ownership, injected clock/deadlines and remaining rounds.
  It blocks arbitrary prose, refs, claims and attachments; only the two exact registered templates
  are admitted. Valid output includes hashes of exact Arena message bytes, economic fingerprint
  and bounded expiry. Bytes are available through payload_bytes; no artifact storage/dispatch
  capability or live-readiness claim is implied by a DTO certificate.

  without arithmetic. Strategies and execution import core only, preserving the import boundary.

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Protocol

from . import models


class Clock(Protocol):
    def utcnow(self) -> datetime: ...

    def monotonic(self) -> float: ...


class OfficialCostOracle(Protocol):
    def evaluate(
        self,
        case: models.CaseContract,
        terms: models.ResolvedTerms,
        supplier: models.SupplierEstimate | None,
    ) -> models.OfficialCostResult: ...


class CanonicalClaimOracle(Protocol):
    def verify(
        self,
        candidate: models.ClaimCandidate,
        evidence: models.EvidenceContext,
        recipient_id: str,
        usage: tuple[models.ClaimUsage, ...],
    ) -> models.ClaimVerificationResult: ...


class ContextBuilder(Protocol):
    def build_context(
        self,
        prepared: models.PreparedEvidence,
        case: models.CaseContract,
        server: models.ServerState,
        documents: tuple[models.DocumentRecord, ...],
        as_of: datetime,
    ) -> models.EvidenceContext: ...


class SupplierInterpreter(Protocol):
    async def interpret(
        self,
        context: models.NegotiationContext,
        conversation: models.ConversationView,
        previous_assessment: models.SupplierAssessment | None,
        budget: models.DecisionBudget,
    ) -> models.SupplierAssessment: ...


class StrategyProposalPolicy(Protocol):
    async def propose_strategies(
        self,
        context: models.NegotiationContext,
        assessment: models.SupplierAssessment,
        state: models.NegotiationState,
        budget: models.DecisionBudget,
        research: models.CandidateResearch,
    ) -> models.IntentBatch: ...


class CandidateGenerator(Protocol):
    def generate_candidates(
        self,
        intent: models.StrategyIntent,
        context: models.NegotiationContext,
        state: models.NegotiationState,
        budget: models.DecisionBudget,
    ) -> models.GenerationResult: ...


class EconomicEvaluator(Protocol):
    def evaluate_package(
        self,
        package: models.Package,
        supplier_id: str,
        context: models.EconomicContext,
    ) -> models.PackageEvaluation: ...

    def evaluate_candidates(
        self,
        candidates: tuple[models.CandidateAction, ...],
        context: models.NegotiationContext,
    ) -> models.EvaluationBatch: ...


class ActionSelectionPolicy(Protocol):
    async def select_action(
        self,
        candidates: models.EvaluationBatch,
        assessment: models.SupplierAssessment,
        state: models.NegotiationState,
        budget: models.DecisionBudget,
        research: models.CandidateResearch,
    ) -> models.NegotiationDecision: ...


class CandidateResearch(Protocol):
    async def evaluate_intents(
        self,
        intents: models.IntentBatch,
        budget: models.DecisionBudget,
    ) -> models.EvaluationBatch: ...


class ClosingEvaluator(Protocol):
    def decide_close(
        self,
        context: models.NegotiationContext,
        state: models.NegotiationState,
        reason_code: str,
    ) -> models.CloseDecision: ...


class ClaimVerifier(Protocol):
    def verify(
        self,
        candidate: models.ClaimCandidate,
        evidence: models.EvidenceContext,
        recipient_id: str,
        usage: tuple[models.ClaimUsage, ...],
    ) -> models.ClaimVerificationResult: ...


class ActionRenderer(Protocol):
    def render(
        self,
        decision: models.NegotiationDecision | models.CloseDecision,
        selected: models.EvaluatedCandidate | None,
        claims: tuple[models.VerifiedClaim, ...],
        context: models.NegotiationContext,
    ) -> models.RenderedAction: ...


class ActionValidator(Protocol):
    def validate_action(
        self,
        action: models.RenderedAction,
        context: models.NegotiationContext,
        state: models.NegotiationState,
        budget: models.DecisionBudget,
    ) -> models.ValidationResult: ...


class DecisionEngine(Protocol):
    async def decide(self, snapshot: models.DecisionSnapshot) -> models.DecisionOutcome: ...


class FeedbackProcessor(Protocol):
    def process_feedback(
        self,
        previous_state: models.NegotiationState,
        operation: models.PendingOperation,
        response: models.ConversationMessage,
    ) -> tuple[models.EventProposal, ...]: ...


class StateProjector(Protocol):
    def apply_event(
        self,
        state: models.NegotiationState,
        event: models.NegotiationEvent,
    ) -> models.NegotiationState: ...


class StateStore(Protocol):
    async def load_state(self, run_id: str, case_id: str) -> models.NegotiationState: ...

    async def persist_state(
        self,
        expected_version: int,

class MinimumCostTestSelector:
    async def select_action(
        self,
        candidates: m.EvaluationBatch,
        assessment: m.SupplierAssessment,
        state: m.NegotiationState,
        budget: m.DecisionBudget,
        research: CandidateResearch,
    ) -> m.NegotiationDecision:
        verify_batch(candidates)
        if any(i.severity == "error" for i in candidates.issues):
            raise ContractViolation("infeasible: batch contains unresolved errors")
        approved = [i for i in candidates.items if i.disposition == "approved"]
        offers = [i for i in approved if i.candidate.contents.kind == "offer"]
        # Questions are an explicit fallback category, never a zero-cost offer.
        if offers:

            def key(i):
                costs = [r.nominal_cost.amount for r in i.economic]
                return min(costs), i.candidate.candidate_id

            chosen = min(offers, key=key)
        else:
            questions = [i for i in approved if i.candidate.contents.kind == "question"]
            if not questions:
                raise ContractViolation("infeasible: no admissible candidate")
            chosen = min(questions, key=lambda i: i.candidate.candidate_id)
        return m.NegotiationDecision(
            decision_id=uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, candidates.batch_hash + chosen.evaluation_id),
            snapshot=candidates.snapshot,
            candidate_id=chosen.candidate.candidate_id,
            evaluation_id=chosen.evaluation_id,
            approved_batch_hash=candidates.batch_hash,
            selector_id="minimum-cost-test-v1",
            rationale="Test baseline chooses supplied admissible cost minimum.",
            citations=(),
        )

### Interpreter contract

**Owns:** attributed commercial observations and separate preference hypotheses. **May call:** injected ModelGateway and deterministic fallback. **State:** none beyond version-keyed cache. Inputs include the conversation, previous assessment, and filtered evidence view; outputs cite source spans/revisions.

Async model request with an initial eight-second maximum subject to the smaller total remaining budget. Cancellation prevents result application; no daemon thread may later change state. Validate schema, ID scope, quote spans, enum fields and unknown-vs-observed distinctions. Exact quote alone does not prove entailment or sender approval authority. Supplier statements remain statements even if forcefully expressed; supporting/contradictory canonical data is retained. Do not turn “longer term might help” into an observed 5% discount. Fallback returns `status=fallback`, preserves previous valid hypotheses with stale labels, and extracts only safely observed structured fields/known literal signals. If nothing is grounded, output explicit unknowns; do not synthesize a successful interpretation.

Tests use fake model transports for output/control faults and manually labelled recorded/edited P10 replies for semantics. Live model evaluation is a separately authorized future activity. External text has data delimiters, bounded input, no transport tools and no credential/private-economic input.

### Strategy proposal and selection contracts

Register vetted `StrategyBundle(id, version, proposal_policy, selection_policy, supported_case_types, required_capabilities, memory_schema?, config_schema, prompt_versions)` in a local Python registry. Resolve configuration before opening; unknown bundles and incompatible capabilities fail preflight. No arbitrary model-selected Python imports or service plugins.

Proposal and selection are separate replaceable policies but can share a bundle's private pure algorithm. Proposal emits nonbinding intent kinds/dimensions/directions and evidence refs; it supplies neither authoritative prices nor arbitrary contractual values. Selection may choose only approved items from the exact batch hash. A selected question/close request may have no package cost; that must not become zero cost in ranking. V1Adapter wraps its existing deterministic decision and passes it to the same economic/validation boundary; it is distinct from the pure `baseline` strategy ported for V2 fallback. A legacy hold becomes a typed hold; a legacy close/accept/walk recommendation becomes a request for the coordinator's fresh closing evaluation, with the original recommendation retained as a diagnostic artifact. Legacy offer sheets become candidates and must pass independent checks. Legacy body text is retained for comparison but adapted execution uses the reviewed renderer; that can change behavior and is recorded as `v1-adapted`, never silently relabelled `v1-legacy`.

`CandidateResearch` is a closure over the same snapshot and bounded candidate/evaluation budget. It lets lookahead/optimization request more intent-generated candidates. Additional candidates pass the same evaluator and are added to an auditable batch before final selection. The facade registers the immutable union of evaluated batches; `approved_batch_hash` identifies that final registered set, and the engine checks both ID membership and evaluation identity against it. A selector cannot choose an ID from an unrecorded simulation. Strategy implementations can run private opponent simulation through an injected model gateway, but simulated replies are tagged hypothetical and never passed as authoritative `ServerObservation`.

Failures: empty proposals use baseline intent; unsupported intent yields a rejection; selection timeout/invalid ID/edited economics uses deterministic approved fallback. If no approved action exists, request deterministic close evaluation or recovery/cannot-decide rather than emit an invalid package. def _current(temporal, as_of):
    return temporal.status == "current" and all(
        value is None or value <= as_of for value in (temporal.observed_at, temporal.published_at)
    ) and all(value is None or value <= as_of.date() for value in (
        temporal.data_as_of, temporal.valid_from,
    )) and (temporal.valid_to is None or temporal.valid_to >= as_of.date())

    def construct(

        if as_of.tzinfo is None or as_of.utcoffset() is None:
            raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: estimate as_of requires an aware clock")

        if not cost.source_refs or any(i.severity == "error" for i in cost.issues):
            raise ContractViolation("missing_source: cost projection is unavailable")
        if not _current(cost.temporal, as_of) or not _current(assumptions.temporal, as_of):
            raise ContractViolation("stale_source: cost and assumptions must be explicitly current")
        if assumptions.kind not in {"estimate", "hypothesis"} or not isinstance(assumptions.payload, EstimateRecord):
            raise ContractViolation("unsupported_claim: explicit internal estimate assumptions are required")

        if payload.method_id != "source-cost-v1":
            raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: source-cost-v1 mapping required")

            raise ContractViolation("unknown_basis: source-cost estimate supports one part")
        if assumptions.scope.supplier_ids != (supplier_id,) or assumptions.scope.part_ids != basis.part_ids:
            raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: assumptions require explicit single supplier and part targets")
        for scope in (cost.scope, assumptions.scope):
            if scope.supplier_ids and supplier_id not in scope.supplier_ids:
                raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: supplier outside cost/assumption scope")
            if scope.part_ids and set(scope.part_ids) != set(basis.part_ids):
                raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: cost and assumptions must refer to the same part")
            if scope.level == "basket":
                raise ContractViolation("unknown_basis: basket estimate mapping is unsupported")
        if assumptions.scope.case_id != cost.scope.case_id:
            raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: cost and assumptions require the same declared case scope")
        if not all(ref in payload.assumptions for ref in cost.source_refs):
            raise ContractViolation("missing_source: assumptions must cite the exact cost-source revision")
        named = {value.name: value for value in payload.values}
        required = {"full_cost", "interest_rate", "usual_rate", "ppm", "extra_per_unit"}

        if full.value != cost.unit_cost.amount:

        if full.range_low is None or full.range_high is None:

        if named["ppm"].value != named["ppm"].value.to_integral_value():
            raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: ppm assumption must be integral")
        for name in ("interest_rate", "usual_rate", "ppm", "extra_per_unit"):
            value = named[name]
            if value.range_low is not None and (value.range_low != value.value or value.range_high != value.value):
                raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: non-cost ranges require explicit scenarios")
        if not {"payment_days", "incoterm"}.issubset(t.field for t in standard.bindings):
            raise ContractViolation("missing_source: cash-value reference standards require payment and incoterm")

            estimate_id="pending", supplier_id=supplier_id, basis=basis, full_cost=cost.unit_cost,
            full_cost_low=type(cost.unit_cost)(amount=full.range_low, basis=basis),
            full_cost_high=type(cost.unit_cost)(amount=full.range_high, basis=basis),
            interest_rate=named["interest_rate"].value, usual_rate=named["usual_rate"].value,
            ppm=int(named["ppm"].value), extra_per_unit=extra.value, standard=standard,
            assumption_refs=refs, method_id="source-cost-v1",
            uncertainty_kind="unknown" if full.range_low == full.range_high else "scenario_range",
        )

These are first-slice policy defaults, not legal invariants or a learned supplier model.

One outstanding logical operation per case. Persist exact request bytes and operation ID before dispatch. Unknown transport outcomes remain owned after retry exhaustion; never release claims or infer cancellation. Reconciliation reuses original ID/bytes only when current admissibility and idempotency evidence permit it; otherwise retain recovery_required. Unknown open cannot create another open. Input records remain available to the caller as the shadowed revision archive.
Temporal status is preserved; this increment does not derive freshness or truth.

from ..core.models import Conflict, EvidenceRecord, Issue, IssueCode

_PRIORITY = {"base": 0, "release": 1, "case": 2}
_RULE = "base-release-case/1"


def _issue(code: IssueCode, refs: tuple[str, ...], detail: str) -> Issue:
    return Issue(code=code, severity="error", component="evidence.resolver", refs=refs, detail=detail)


def _applicable(record: EvidenceRecord, case_id: str, suppliers: tuple[str, ...], parts: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
    scope = record.scope
    if scope.case_id is not None and scope.case_id != case_id:
        return False
    if scope.supplier_ids and not set(scope.supplier_ids).intersection(suppliers):
        return False
    if scope.part_ids and not set(scope.part_ids).intersection(parts):
        return False
    # Payload ownership cannot be broadened by an incomplete outer scope.
    supplier = getattr(record.payload, "supplier", None)
    part = getattr(record.payload, "part", None)
    payload_parts = getattr(record.payload, "part_ids", ())
    return not (
        supplier is not None and supplier not in suppliers
        or part is not None and part not in parts
        or payload_parts and not set(payload_parts).intersection(parts)
    )


class LayeredEvidenceResolver:
    def resolve(
        self,
        records: tuple[EvidenceRecord, ...],
        *,
        case_id: str,
        supplier_ids: tuple[str, ...],
        part_ids: tuple[str, ...],
    ) -> tuple[tuple[EvidenceRecord, ...], tuple[Conflict, ...], tuple[Issue, ...]]:
        """Return selected applicable revisions, resolution conflicts, and blocking issues.

        Unsupported layers and conflicting record identities fail closed for affected
        canonical groups. Unkeyed records resolve only by their own record identity.
        An applicable lower version never revives an inapplicable higher version.

"""One injected offline decision, with reproducible diagnostics and exact message bytes."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from typing import Literal, TypeVar

from pydantic import ValidationError

from ..core import models as m
from ..core.certificates import candidate_id, economic_fingerprint, verify_batch
from ..core.errors import ContractViolation
from ..core.ports import (
    ActionRenderer, ActionSelectionPolicy, ActionValidator, CandidateGenerator, CandidateResearch,
    Clock, EconomicEvaluator, StrategyProposalPolicy, SupplierInterpreter,
)
from ..core.serialization import canonical_json, semantic_hash

T = TypeVar("T")


class OfflineStage(m.FrozenModel):
    name: Literal["snapshot", "interpretation", "proposal", "generation", "evaluation", "selection", "rendering", "validation"]
    status: Literal["completed", "failed"]
    issues: tuple[m.Issue, ...]


class OfflineDecisionTrace(m.FrozenModel):
    """Local diagnostic artifact, never a durable DecisionRecord or execution permit."""
    snapshot: m.SnapshotRef
    snapshot_bytes: bytes
    recorded_input_bytes: bytes
    input_hash: str
    components: tuple[str, ...]
    stages: tuple[OfflineStage, ...]
    assessment: m.SupplierAssessment | None = None
    intents: m.IntentBatch | None = None
    generations: tuple[m.GenerationResult, ...]
    evaluations: m.EvaluationBatch | None = None
    decision: m.NegotiationDecision | None = None
    rendered: m.RenderedAction | None = None
    validation: m.ValidationResult | None = None
    validated_message_bytes: bytes | None = None
    issues: tuple[m.Issue, ...]
    outcome: m.DecisionOutcome
    trace_hash: str

    def verify(self):
        if semantic_hash(self.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"trace_hash"})) != self.trace_hash:
            raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: offline trace digest mismatch")
        if hashlib.sha256(self.recorded_input_bytes or self.snapshot_bytes).hexdigest() != self.input_hash:
            raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: offline input bytes mismatch")
        if self.validated_message_bytes is not None:
            if self.validation is None or self.validation.kind != "valid" or hashlib.sha256(
                self.validated_message_bytes,
            ).hexdigest() != self.validation.action.payload_hash:
                raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: trace bytes do not match validation certificate")


def _issue(error, component):
    code = str(error).split(":", 1)[0]
    if isinstance(error, TimeoutError):
        code = "deadline_exhausted"
    if code not in m.IssueCode.__args__:
        code = "invalid_schema"
    return m.Issue(code=code, severity="error", component=component, refs=(), detail=str(error)[:1000] or "boundary failure")


def _citation(citation, snapshot):
    if isinstance(citation, m.SourceRef):
        record = next((r for r in snapshot.context.evidence.records if r.record_id == citation.record_id), None)
        if record is None or (citation.canonical_id is not None and citation.canonical_id != record.canonical_id):
            raise ContractViolation("missing_source: cited source revision is not in resolved context")
        return
    message = next((msg for msg in snapshot.conversation.messages if msg.message_id == citation.message_id), None)
    if (message is None or citation.session_id != message.session_id or citation.thread_id != message.thread_id
            or message.body[citation.start:citation.end] != citation.quote or citation.end > len(message.body)):
        raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: citation is not an exact scoped message span")


def _assessment(assessment, snapshot):
    if assessment.snapshot != snapshot.context.snapshot or assessment.supplier_id != snapshot.target_supplier_id:
        raise ContractViolation("stale_state: interpretation returned another snapshot/recipient")
    observations = {o.observation_id for o in assessment.observations}
    for item in (*assessment.observations, *assessment.reported_constraints, *assessment.uncertainties, *assessment.questions):
        for citation in item.citations:
            _citation(citation, snapshot)
    for constraint in assessment.reported_constraints:
        if not set(constraint.condition_observation_refs) <= observations:
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: constraint condition refers to absent observation")
    for uncertainty in assessment.uncertainties:
        if not set(uncertainty.related_observation_refs) <= observations:
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: uncertainty refers to absent observation")
    for hypothesis in assessment.hypotheses:
        for citation in (*hypothesis.supporting_refs, *hypothesis.contradicting_refs,
                         *(hypothesis.numeric_effect.citations if hypothesis.numeric_effect else ())):
            _citation(citation, snapshot)


class NoAdditionalResearch:
    """Explicit unavailable lookahead seam; no hidden simulation or new batches."""
    async def evaluate_intents(self, intents: m.IntentBatch, budget: m.DecisionBudget) -> m.EvaluationBatch:
        raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: additional candidate research disabled in offline slice")


class OfflineDecisionCoordinator:
    def __init__(
        self, *, interpreter: SupplierInterpreter, proposal: StrategyProposalPolicy,
        generator: CandidateGenerator, evaluator: EconomicEvaluator, selector: ActionSelectionPolicy,
        renderer_factory: Callable[[m.EvaluationBatch], ActionRenderer], validator: ActionValidator,
        payload_encoder: Callable[[m.MessagePayload], bytes], clock: Clock, research: CandidateResearch | None = None,
    ):
        self.interpreter = interpreter
        self.proposal = proposal
        self.generator = generator
        self.evaluator = evaluator
        self.selector = selector
        self.renderer_factory = renderer_factory
        self.validator = validator
        self.payload_encoder = payload_encoder
        self.clock = clock
        if research is not None:
            raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: registering research batches remains incomplete")
        self.research = NoAdditionalResearch()

    async def decide(self, snapshot: m.DecisionSnapshot) -> m.DecisionOutcome:
        return (await self.run_once(snapshot)).outcome

    async def run_once(
        self, snapshot: m.DecisionSnapshot, *, previous_assessment: m.SupplierAssessment | None = None,
        recorded_input_bytes: bytes = b"",
    ) -> OfflineDecisionTrace:
        raw_snapshot = canonical_json(snapshot)
        ref = snapshot.context.snapshot
        stages = []
        issues = []
        generations = []
        assessment = intents = batch = decision = rendered = validation = payload = None
        phase = "snapshot"
        started = self.clock.monotonic()

        def remaining():
            utc = (snapshot.budget.deadline_at - self.clock.utcnow()).total_seconds()
            compute = float(snapshot.budget.compute_limit_s) - (self.clock.monotonic() - started)
            return min(utc, compute)

        def available():
            if remaining() <= 0:
                raise ContractViolation("deadline_exhausted: offline decision budget exhausted")

        async def bounded(call: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:
            available()
            return await asyncio.wait_for(call(), timeout=remaining())

        def completed():
            stages.append(OfflineStage(name=phase, status="completed", issues=()))

        try:
            snapshot = m.DecisionSnapshot.model_validate_json(raw_snapshot)
            if snapshot.state.version != ref.state_version:
                raise ContractViolation("stale_state: decision state version differs from snapshot")
            context = snapshot.context
            if (context.evidence.as_of != context.as_of or context.as_of > self.clock.utcnow()
                    or "sha256:" + semantic_hash(context.evidence.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"context_version"}))
                    != ref.context_version or economic_fingerprint(context.economic) != context.economic.fingerprint):
                raise ContractViolation("stale_state: stale or edited context projection")
            if any(i.severity == "error" for i in (*context.evidence.gaps, *context.economic.issues)) or any(
                c.blocking for c in context.evidence.conflicts
            ):
                raise ContractViolation("source_conflict: snapshot has unresolved evidence/economic errors")
            if snapshot.state.runtime_status not in ("ready", "deciding") or any(
                o.status in ("prepared", "submitted", "uncertain") for o in snapshot.state.operations
            ):
                raise ContractViolation("operation_pending: decision has unresolved ownership")
            if previous_assessment is not None and (previous_assessment.supplier_id != snapshot.target_supplier_id
                    or previous_assessment.snapshot.run_id != ref.run_id
                    or previous_assessment.snapshot.session_id != ref.session_id
                    or previous_assessment.snapshot.state_version > ref.state_version):
                raise ContractViolation("stale_state: previous assessment belongs to another/future state")
            available()
            completed()
            phase = "interpretation"
            assessment = await bounded(lambda: self.interpreter.interpret(
                context, snapshot.conversation, previous_assessment, snapshot.budget,
            ))
            assessment = m.SupplierAssessment.model_validate_json(assessment.model_dump_json())
            _assessment(assessment, snapshot)
            completed()
            phase = "proposal"
            intents = await bounded(lambda: self.proposal.propose_strategies(
                context, assessment, snapshot.state, snapshot.budget, self.research,
            ))
            intents = m.IntentBatch.model_validate_json(intents.model_dump_json())
            if intents.snapshot != ref or not intents.intents or len(intents.intents) > snapshot.budget.candidate_limit:
                raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: proposal returned empty/oversized/stale intent batch")
            for intent in intents.intents:
                if intent.supplier_id != snapshot.target_supplier_id:
                    raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: proposed intent targets another supplier")
                if not set(intent.observation_refs) <= {o.observation_id for o in assessment.observations}:
                    raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: intent references unknown observation")
                for citation in intent.evidence_refs:
                    _citation(citation, snapshot)
            if any(i.severity == "error" for i in intents.issues):
                raise ContractViolation("infeasible: proposal contains unresolved errors")
            completed()
            phase = "generation"
            for intent in intents.intents:
                available()
                generated = self.generator.generate_candidates(intent, context, snapshot.state, snapshot.budget)
                generated = m.GenerationResult.model_validate_json(generated.model_dump_json())
                generations.append(generated)
                issues.extend(generated.rejections)
                if generated.intent_id != intent.intent_id or any(
                    c.intent_id != intent.intent_id or c.supplier_id != snapshot.target_supplier_id
                    or c.snapshot != ref or c.candidate_id != candidate_id(c) for c in generated.candidates
                ):
                    raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: generator returned forged candidate/snapshot")
            candidates = tuple(c for g in generations for c in g.candidates)
            if not candidates or len(candidates) > min(20, snapshot.budget.candidate_limit):
                raise ContractViolation("infeasible: no candidates or global candidate budget exceeded")
            completed()
            phase = "evaluation"
            available()
            batch = self.evaluator.evaluate_candidates(candidates, context)
            batch = m.EvaluationBatch.model_validate_json(batch.model_dump_json())
            verify_batch(batch)
            if batch.snapshot != ref or {i.candidate.candidate_id for i in batch.items} != {c.candidate_id for c in candidates}:
                raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: evaluator changed registered candidate membership")
            issues.extend(i for item in batch.items for i in item.issues)
            completed()
            phase = "selection"
            decision = await bounded(lambda: self.selector.select_action(
                batch, assessment, snapshot.state, snapshot.budget, self.research,
            ))
            decision = m.NegotiationDecision.model_validate_json(decision.model_dump_json())
            selected = next((i for i in batch.items if i.candidate.candidate_id == decision.candidate_id), None)
            if (selected is None or selected.disposition != "approved" or decision.snapshot != ref
                    or decision.approved_batch_hash != batch.batch_hash or decision.evaluation_id != selected.evaluation_id):
                raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: selection is not an approved registered batch member")
            for citation in decision.citations:
                _citation(citation, snapshot)
            completed()
            phase = "rendering"
            available()
            rendered = self.renderer_factory(batch).render(decision, selected, (), context)
            rendered = m.RenderedAction.model_validate_json(rendered.model_dump_json())
            contents = selected.candidate.contents
            expected_packages = contents.packages if isinstance(contents, m.OfferAction) else ()
            if (rendered.snapshot != ref or rendered.supplier_id != snapshot.target_supplier_id
                    or rendered.decision_ref != "sha256:" + semantic_hash(decision)
                    or rendered.kind != contents.kind or rendered.payload.packages != expected_packages):
                raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: renderer edited the selected action")
            completed()
            phase = "validation"
            available()
            validation = self.validator.validate_action(rendered, context, snapshot.state, snapshot.budget)
            from pydantic import TypeAdapter

            validation = TypeAdapter(m.ValidationResult).validate_json(validation.model_dump_json())
            if validation.kind == "invalid":
                issues.extend(validation.report.issues)
                raise ContractViolation("infeasible: independent used-action validation rejected selection")
            certificate = validation.action
            if (certificate.rendered != rendered or certificate.report.snapshot != ref
                    or certificate.economic_fingerprint != context.economic.fingerprint
                    or certificate.expires_at <= self.clock.utcnow()
                    or certificate.expires_at > snapshot.budget.deadline_at):
                raise ContractViolation("stale_state: validation certificate is expired or inconsistent")
            wire = self.payload_encoder(rendered.payload)
            if hashlib.sha256(wire).hexdigest() != certificate.payload_hash:
                raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: exact bytes differ from validated message")
            available()
            payload = wire
            completed()
            outcome = m.SelectedOutcome(kind="selected", decision=decision)
        except (ContractViolation, ValidationError, TimeoutError) as error:
            failure = _issue(error, "orchestration.offline:" + phase)
            issues.append(failure)
            stages.append(OfflineStage(name=phase, status="failed", issues=(failure,)))
            outcome = m.CannotDecideOutcome(kind="cannot_decide", snapshot=ref, issues=tuple(issues))
        trace = OfflineDecisionTrace(
            snapshot=ref, snapshot_bytes=raw_snapshot, recorded_input_bytes=recorded_input_bytes,
            input_hash=hashlib.sha256(recorded_input_bytes or raw_snapshot).hexdigest(),
            components=tuple(type(component).__module__ + "." + type(component).__qualname__ for component in (
                self.interpreter, self.proposal, self.generator, self.evaluator, self.selector, self.validator,
            )), stages=tuple(stages), assessment=assessment, intents=intents, generations=tuple(generations),
            evaluations=batch, decision=decision, rendered=rendered, validation=validation,
            validated_message_bytes=payload, issues=tuple(issues), outcome=outcome, trace_hash="0" * 64,
        )
        trace = trace.model_copy(update={"trace_hash": semantic_hash(trace.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"trace_hash"}))})
        trace.verify()
        return trace

cat >> docs/v2/implementation-order-addendum-2026-10-10.md <<'MD'

## M. Typed recorded assembly and one complete offline decision — 11 October 2026

Implemented an input-only typed path through layered resolution, admitted cost projection,
explicit source-cost estimate construction, actual official evaluation, replaceable interpretation/
strategy ports, finite generation, registered selection, rendering and independent validation.
No source/fixture identity selects prewritten winners. The fixed test interpretation and strategy
components are labelled as such; this is not negotiation intelligence or checkpoint A/B completion.

**New core contracts: exactly ten.** FileDigest, SourceManifest, ScopeIndex, PreparedEvidence
complete the D2 schema inventory. DecisionSnapshot, SelectedOutcome, RequestCloseOutcome,
HoldOutcome, CannotDecideOutcome and the complete DecisionOutcome union complete D11. The
remaining deferred contracts are not prerequisites of this bounded path. No public port,
existing DTO field, tagged union or existing assertion was changed.

**Working components and ownership:**

- `adapters/offline.py`: OfflineRecordedInputs and RecordedCostAssumption are private adapter
  inputs, using existing strict domain models; load_recorded_json decodes JSON without inference,
  winner selection, evaluation labels or desired actions. This focused codec does **not** satisfy
  the entire C §8.5 RecordedInputs inventory or existing adapters.recorded fixture acceptance.
  OfflineContextAssembler injects ContextBuilder, cost projection and estimate construction.
  It joins the recorded case/state/server/target, actual resolved cost revisions, explicitly
  cited assumptions and matching declared current canonical quote terms for supplier standards.
  It constructs the single explicit nominal scenario or disabled mode, economic fingerprint,
  negotiation context and decision snapshot. Missing/shadowed citations, conflicting/inapplicable
  evidence, stale costs/quotes and requested obsolete context revisions fail explicitly.
- `evidence/context.py`: LayeredContextBuilder implements the existing ContextBuilder port,
  using LayeredEvidenceResolver with precedence before applicability. It checks the preparation
  projection digest and rejects unsupported document hydration. Original records remain in
  PreparedEvidence; selected context records preserve provenance/disclosure/basis. Only explicit
  date contradictions derive future/stale temporal status. Unknown/stale records never become
  current through a new clock alone. Freshness-rule execution and source-byte authentication
  remain incomplete; hashes establish typed projection consistency, not independent authenticity.
- `intelligence/testing.py`: InputEchoTestInterpreter retains exact supplier messages as cited,
  uninterpreted ambiguity observations with fallback status and explicit unknowns. Previous
  assessment linkage is retained. It has no preference inference, offer approval or numerical
  authority. Relevant and irrelevant raw supplier input both reach this port and its output;
  the test strategies deliberately supply no language-conditioned negotiation policy.
- `orchestration/offline.py`: OfflineDecisionCoordinator implements DecisionEngine.decide and
  an additional local run_once returning OfflineDecisionTrace. Every decision dependency is
  injected. Rendering uses an injected batch-bound renderer factory; message encoding and clock
  are also injected. The coordinator checks context/case/state/version/session consistency,
  exact source/message citations, intent references, candidate identity, unchanged evaluated
  membership, approved selection identity, rendering fidelity, validation fingerprint/expiry
  and exact message-byte digest. Async calls share the absolute/compute time bound; synchronous
  algorithms remain the existing finite local components. Errors become typed cannot-decide
  outcomes and failed stages; cancellation is not swallowed. No executor is available.
- `factory.py:run_recorded_decision`: the small composition entry reparses typed input, calls
  the injected assembler and passes its snapshot, previous assessment and exact canonical input
  bytes into the coordinator. Full config/bundle resolution and the original complete
  build_offline_runtime/OfflineRuntime acceptance remain incomplete.
- `core/certificates.py`: canonical economic/case projections are shared by assembly and existing
  official consumers; no arithmetic was duplicated or changed.

**Reproducible local trace:** OfflineDecisionTrace is an internal diagnostic artifact, not a
persisted DecisionRecord, operation, permit or state authority. It retains exact recorded input
and snapshot bytes, component identities, stage status, assessment, intents, generated candidates
and rejections, package evaluations (including rejected alternatives), selection/batch identity,
rendered action, validation issues/certificate and exact validated Arena message bytes. Its
content hash and byte digests can be verified after JSON export/reload. Failed/expired validation
retains diagnostic artifacts but produces no admitted message bytes. Assembly errors raise
ContractViolation before creating a commercial decision snapshot; they do not fabricate an
outcome with an invented session/context identity. Durable append/reload, operation ownership,
execution and feedback remain separate incomplete capabilities.

**Controlled demonstration:** the same EUR 45/49 packages now start from typed preparation,
source records, quoted standards, recorded message history and declared server/state input.
Applicable source EUR 43 selects EUR 45; source EUR 47 selects EUR 49, ending in independently
validated no-claim offers. Original source/assumption refs reach evaluations. Disabled estimates
preserve the unchanged economic control. Changed supplier wording reaches interpretation and
proposal/selection consumers; greeting differences leave package economics and selected package
unchanged. Replacement interpreter/proposal/selector test doubles use the same coordinator,
economics, renderer and validator. The existing K/L reversal tests remain unchanged.

**Safety controls:** stale context/state and economic hashes, conflicting evidence, missing quote
or assumption attribution, expired cost validity, winning scope mismatch, invalid server input,
inconsistent conversation/snapshots, forged generated IDs, unknown intent observation refs,
ungrounded quote spans, forged selection, private rendered prose, late/expired certificates and
trace-byte tampering fail. A registered clarification completes the same path without being
ranked as a zero-cost package; rejected offer generation remains in the trace.

**Contract handoff discrepancy:** the existing positive DecisionSnapshot example has state
version 1 and snapshot version 0. Preserve its existing structural round-trip acceptance; the
coordinator rejects that mismatch before interpretation. This is an explicit service gate, not
permission to execute inconsistent examples, a weakened existing test or a public revision.

**Verification:** new offline integration 28 passed; the complete remaining-DTO suite with D2/D11
required 619 passed, 244 explicit absent-export xfails. Whole scoped V2: **1,013 passed,
364 explicit unimplemented xfails**, zero unexpected failures. Expanded manifest: 1,377 cases.
V2 Ruff, diff whitespace checks and frozen V1 first move (3653046) pass. The complete repository
regression run, with localhost test-server access outside the restricted sandbox, is **1,341
passed, 19 skipped, 364 xfailed, 17 failed**. All failures are outside V2, in unchanged legacy
context (2), evaluator (3), inference (4), Lab campaign (2), runner (5) and scaffold (1) tests.
This expands A's bounded four-failure observation; it is not a repository readiness claim.
Repository-wide Ruff reports four findings in unchanged legacy evaluator/guards/runner files;
V2 source/tests are clean. No V1 repair, dependency/default change, hosted inference, real Arena
execution, commit or push was performed.

Reproduce M's whole scoped gate by using L's complete command, adding:

```bash
--v2-require adapters.offline --v2-require evidence.context \
--v2-require intelligence.testing --v2-require orchestration.offline --v2-require factory \
--v2-dto-require D2 --v2-dto-require D11
```

Focused checks and full repository regression (localhost server permission is required for the latter):

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/v2/integration/test_offline_decision.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/v2/contracts/test_remaining_dtos.py --v2-dto-require D2 --v2-dto-require D11
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests
.venv/bin/ruff check src/negotiator/v2 tests/v2
.venv/bin/python tests/v2/replay_v1_baseline.py
```

**Minimum dependencies for first LLM components:** the SupplierInterpreter and
ActionSelectionPolicy seams are exercised and replaceable. The existing ModelGateway contract
closure still needs 15 exports: InterpretInput, SelectionOption, SelectInput, SimulateInput,
ModelInput, ModelRequest, ModelBudget, ModelUsage, ModelSuccess, ModelRefused, ModelInvalid,
ModelTimeout, ModelCapacityUnavailable, ModelTransportFailure and ModelResult. The first bounded
model selector also needs SelectorResponse. Preserve all members of ModelInput/ModelResult even
when the first consumer uses only interpretation/selection. Then implement purpose-specific
private-data filtering, schema/span/reference validation and semantic grounding, explicit
provider/protocol/prompt configuration, total call/token/time budgets, cancellation/late-result
rejection, refusal/malformed/timeout controls, deterministic fallback and model usage/raw-output
attribution. Start with fake transports and recorded drafts; hosted use needs separately approved
usage and independent evaluations. Full offline persistence is not a prerequisite for those
component tests; no live sending follows from them.

The existing ModelRequest tasks are interpret/select/simulate; there is **no registered propose
request**. The first gateway-compatible LLM strategist is therefore a bounded approved-ID selector
behind ActionSelectionPolicy. A model-driven StrategyProposalPolicy needs an explicitly settled
purpose/output projection before gateway integration; do not add a generic payload or silently
reinterpret a registered task. No coordinator/economics/validator rewrite is required for either
strategy port. Read-only research registration, complete fixture codec/config composition,
grounded negotiation behavior, broad preparation/freshness/authentication, robust multi-scenario
policy, claims/closing, durable records and live execution remain unfinished.
